topics.title: Ceuta crossing draws EU attention
topics.summary: Spain is asking Europe for help after a large crossing into Ceuta from Morocco sparked a tense border response and renewed debate over migration policy.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a border town gets overwhelmed fast, what should come first: practical aid, clearer rules, or calmer public messaging?

topics.title: FIFA plan faces soccer pushback
topics.summary: UEFA says it has lost confidence in FIFA President Gianni Infantino after his failed plan to bring private investors into World Cup commercial rights.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would you rather your favorite sport chase a huge payday, or keep its biggest event run the old-fashioned way?

topics.title: August eclipse gets skywatchers planning
topics.summary: A total solar eclipse later this month will cross parts of Spain, Iceland and Greenland, with astronomy fans already planning trips and safety-viewing setups.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would you travel for a few minutes of total darkness, or is that the kind of thing you enjoy from someone else's photos?

topics.title: WHO challenges ultra-processed food lawsuits
topics.summary: The WHO says some ultra-processed food companies are using lawsuits to slow public health rules, including efforts aimed at obesity and clearer consumer information.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a snack label got brutally honest, would that change what you buy, or would taste still win the argument?
